# tests/fixtures/

Test data that's safe to commit — **all of it made up.** No real timing data goes here, even a few rows.

`synthetic_race.CSV` is a fake 4-lap race with 3 cars, in the same format as the real files. Car 007 pits on lap 3 and changes driver on the way out, so the pit and stint logic has something to work on. It's small enough to check every expected answer by hand, which is the point.
